json_schema.title: network.ping
json_schema.description: Performs an ICMP ping to a host

timeout.ui:title: Timeout
timeout.ui:description: Time to wait for a response, in seconds. The option affects only timeout in absence of any responses, otherwise ping waits for two RTTs

return_boolean.ui:title: Return Boolean
return_boolean.ui:description: Toggle to get a simple true/false result instead of the full ping details
